---
# BCTU trial report -------------------------------------------------------
# Title page is built by bctu's Lua filter from the keys below. Pandoc's
# own title/author/date keys are ignored. Key reference:
#   ?bctu::trial_report

trial-short-name:    "ACRONYM"
trial-long-name:     "Full trial title goes here"
trial-registration:  "ISRCTN00000000"
report-type:         "Data Monitoring Committee Report"
report-subtype:      "Open Report"          # free text; delete if not needed

# Metadata table (anchored to bottom-left of the title page). Each list
# item is a row; the label is whatever you write before the colon. A value
# may be a string, a list of strings, a {name, role} map, or a list of
# {name, role} maps.
metadata:
  - Date:        "`r format(Sys.Date(), '%d %B %Y')`"
  - Version:     "v1.0"
  - Prepared by:
      - name: "Your Name"
        role: "Trial Statistician"
  - Sponsor:     "University of Birmingham"

# Optional confidentiality page, centred on its own page after the title
# page. Delete the key for no such page.
confidential: "This report is confidential."

# Optional Word table of contents (inserted after the title page, filled with
# the headings; page numbers appear on the first Update Field in Word).
include-toc: true
toc-depth:   3

# Optional theme: report_theme() elements. Anything left out keeps the BCTU
# default (UoB gold accents, Arial 11 pt, Times New Roman title). Children
# inherit: set colour.accent and the rules, borders and header fill follow.
theme:
  colour.accent: "C59A00"
  font.body:     "Arial"
  font.size:     11

output:
  bctu::trial_report: default
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(bctu)
```

# Introduction

Body content starts here. Headings get auto-numbered.

## Landscape section

Wrap wide content in a `::: landscape` fenced div. The fences must each be
on their own line, with a blank line above and below.

::: landscape

```{r example-landscape, opts.label = "fig_landscape", fig.cap = "Example landscape figure."}
plot(cars)
```

:::

## Portrait section

Back to portrait outside the div. Use `opts.label = "fig_portrait"` for
full-width portrait figures.

```{r example-portrait, opts.label = "fig_portrait", fig.cap = "Example portrait figure."}
plot(pressure)
```

Markdown tables get numbered captions too:

Table: Example table caption.

| Group | n  | Mean |
|-------|----|------|
| A     | 10 | 1.2  |
| B     | 12 | 1.5  |

# Layout notes

Wrap a chapter in `::: landscape` ... `:::` for landscape pages, heading
inside the div. Put `::: footnote` ... `:::` straight after a table for its
footnote block. `report_styles()` lists every template style; apply one with
`::: {custom-style="Style Name"}` or `[text]{custom-style="Style Name"}`.
